name: words with following parameter and pipeline
source: Select-Item Red, Blue, Green -OutVariable result | Out-Null

name: mixed projected properties across a comment
source:
Select-Item @{Name='Shade';Expression={$_.Color}}, # calculated field
 Red, Blue, Green -OutVariable result | Out-Null

name: mixed projected properties CRLF
source:
Select-Item @{Name='Shade';Expression={$_.Color}}, # calculated field
 Red, Blue, Green -OutVariable result | Out-Null
Write-Output sentinel

name: export words comma escaped space and comments
source:
Publish-Item Send-Red, `   # first export
 Read-Blue, ` # second export
 Find-Green
Write-Output sentinel

name: export words CRLF
source:
Publish-Item Send-Red, `   # first export
 Read-Blue, ` # second export
 Find-Green
Write-Output sentinel

name: export words lone CR
source: Publish-Item Send-Red, `   # first export Read-Blue, ` # second export Find-GreenWrite-Output sentinel

name: line comment after comma
source:
Publish-Item Red, # first
 Blue, # second
 Green -Quiet

name: block comment between items
source: Publish-Item Red, <# item boundary #> Blue, Green -Quiet

name: word array followed by separate argument

known.reason: Existing proof-kit unitItems includes the comment extra as an array item for a concrete expression array; Native and the CST retain the same two expressions and the comment.
